matches.verified_facts: OLBG's hub also shows 'Draw' as most-tipped (10/20) in the match-result market for this fixture — two different markets point two ways (narrow home win or draw). Our winner pick uses the handicap signal: Nemo +1.5 with 83% support implies a one-score game. Gaelic football matches can end level; our 3-way model carries an explicit draw allowance (see Methodology). Hurling fixtures on OLBG are excluded from this project by the brief and are not listed.
